summary: Optimi Health Corp., a Canadian foreign private issuer, furnished a Form -6K attaching a press release dated October 20, 2026, announcing completion of a GMP-manufactured MDMA finished-drug batch at its Princeton, British Columbia facility under its Health Canada Drug Establishment Licence. The batch is earmarked for a proposed Canadian Phase 3 PTSD trial (up to 100 veterans and frontline workers, expected to begin 2027), a planned pre-year-end commercial export to Australia, and a previously announced Israeli trial with MAPS. No transactional terms, board recommendation, advisor, or ownership change are disclosed; this is an ordinary operational/product update, not a special situation.
